title: StableWallet
tagline: Privy social wallet + Flow DeFi + CCTP bridges. Stablecoins for everyone, everywhere.
description:
Want to handle USDC and EURC as smoothly as sending a text? StableWallet gets you logged in with social accounts, zero seed phrases and lets you move stablecoins across 10+ chains in seconds without getting wrecked by fees.
Two flavors: Easy Mode for newcomers with smart regional defaults and one-tap staking; Expert Mode for full control, sophisticated swaps, and funneling everything to Flow for maximum yield and rock-bottom fees.
Built on serious tech: Privy for frictionless onboarding, Circle's CCTP v2 for native cross-chain transfers, and Flow for lightning-fast, dirt-cheap settlement.
Throw in QR payments and native DeFi earning all baked right into the app. It's basically a bank, exchange, and investment platform that fits in your pocket.
Up and running in under 30 seconds, zero headaches. This is how stablecoins are supposed to work.
how_its_made:
StableWallet runs on Next.js with Privy SDK handling the wallet magic users log in with social accounts and get a functional wallet in seconds. No seed phrases, no MetaMask popups.
Circle's CCTP v2 powers cross-chain transfers by burning USDC on one chain and minting fresh USDC on another. Your money stays real USDC, never some wrapped derivative that could blow up.
Flow as Settlement Hub: New users default to Flow for cheap fees. Expert users get "sweep to Flow" that batches multiple CCTP transfers to consolidate scattered balances. Direct Increment.fi integration means staking happens in-app.
Smart UX: Regional defaults (EU gets EURC, US gets USDC), QR payments with localhost redirects that auto-fill recipient data, and dual-mode architecture powered by React Context.
- Cross-chain aggregation batches multiple CCTP transfers behind one smooth progress bar—technically multiple transactions, feels like magic.
No custom smart contracts for MVP we compose battle-tested protocols (Privy, CCTP, Increment) instead of reinventing wheels. Consumer app experience on institutional-grade infrastructure.
